operations.description: Read one Gmail message from the connected mailbox by its Gmail message ID, returning its sender, recipients, subject, threading headers, labels, and decoded text and HTML bodies.

messageId.description: MessageID is the provider message identifier.

operations.description: Send one new email from the connected Gmail account. Give the recipient email addresses, a one-line subject, and the plain-text body; an HTML body is optional.

inputSchema.description: SendMessageInput contains the provider request fields for send message.

htmlBody.description: HTMLBody is the optional HTML message body.

textBody.description: TextBody is the plain-text message body.

operations.description: Reply in its existing Gmail thread to one message in the connected mailbox, addressed to that message's Reply-To or sender. Give the Gmail message ID to answer and the plain-text reply body; an HTML body is optional.

inputSchema.description: ReplyToMessageInput identifies a message and supplies the reply body.

htmlBody.description: HTMLBody is the optional HTML message body.

messageId.description: MessageID is the provider message identifier.

textBody.description: TextBody is the plain-text message body.
